category_edits.rationale: Dampen repeated items using causal prefix counts: scale each existing input embedding by 1/sqrt(1 + 0.1*c), excluding padding and the current occurrence. Training and inference share this feature through the model class imported by the predictor writer. Embeddings, GRU topology, readout, loss, optimizer, and dataset routing remain unchanged.
